# Rostid Design System — MASTER
*Generated by UI/UX Pro Max Skill · Warm Editorial Minimalism · React 18 + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion*

---

## Step 1 — Product Analysis

| Dimension | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Product type** | Premium DTC e-commerce · food/beverage (specialty coffee) |
| **Brand** | Rostid — *rost* (roast) + *tid* (time) · Stockholm, Sweden |
| **Audience** | Urban coffee enthusiasts, 25–45, willing to pay premium for quality |
| **Style match** | Warm Editorial Minimalism (Scandinavian DTC variant) |
| **Stack** | React 18 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Framer Motion |
| **Breakpoints** | 375 · 640 · 768 · 1024 · 1280 · 1440 |

---

## Step 2 — Design System

### Pattern: Editorial Hero → Product Showcase → Conversion

```
Hero (full-width, dark, editorial typography)
  ↓
Trust signals strip (3 USPs)
  ↓
Product grid (generous whitespace, photography-first)
  ↓
Origin/story section (serif headline + body copy)
  ↓
Subscription CTA (dark anchor)
  ↓
Footer (brand dark)
```

**Core principle:** Let product photography and editorial typography do the work. Every UI element
should feel like it belongs in a high-end print magazine — restrained, confident, nothing decorative.

---

### Style: Warm Editorial Minimalism

| Attribute | Rostid Application |
|-----------|-------------------|
| Layout | Asymmetric editorial grids, generous negative space |
| Hierarchy | Strong size contrast between display and body type |
| Texture | Warm off-white backgrounds, not pure white |
| Photography | Full-bleed product shots, earthy tones |
| Motion | Purposeful, spring-physics, never decorative |
| Icons | SVG only (Heroicons outline 1.5px stroke) |
| Decoration | None. Content is decoration. |

**Anti-patterns to avoid:**
- ❌ Emoji as icons anywhere
- ❌ Gradients on buttons
- ❌ Multiple primary CTAs per section
- ❌ Text smaller than 14px on mobile
- ❌ Pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds — always warm off-white
- ❌ Decorative-only animations
- ❌ Gray text on gray background (check contrast every time)
- ❌ Tight letter spacing on body text

### Typography

#### Fonts
| Role | Font | Source | Weights |
|------|------|--------|---------|
| **Display / Headings** | Playfair Display | Google Fonts | 400 (italic), 600, 700 |
| **Body / UI** | Inter | Google Fonts | 300, 400, 500, 600, 700 |

#### Type Scale
| Style | Font | Size (rem) | Weight | Line Height | Letter Spacing |
|-------|------|-----------|--------|-------------|----------------|
| Display XL | Playfair Display | 4rem (64px) | 600 | 1.1 | -0.02em |
| Display L | Playfair Display | 3rem (48px) | 600 | 1.15 | -0.015em |
| H1 | Playfair Display | 2.25rem (36px) | 600 | 1.2 | -0.01em |
| H2 | Inter | 1.5rem (24px) | 600 | 1.3 | -0.005em |
| H3 | Inter | 1.25rem (20px) | 600 | 1.4 | 0 |
| H4 | Inter | 1.125rem (18px) | 600 | 1.4 | 0 |
| Body L | Inter | 1.125rem (18px) | 400 | 1.7 | 0 |
| Body M | Inter | 1rem (16px) | 400 | 1.65 | 0 |
| Body S | Inter | 0.875rem (14px) | 400 | 1.6 | 0 |
| Caption | Inter | 0.75rem (12px) | 400 | 1.5 | 0.01em |
| Label | Inter | 0.75rem (12px) | 500 | 1.5 | 0.04em |
| Overline | Inter | 0.6875rem (11px) | 500 | 1.5 | 0.1em uppercase |
| Price | Playfair Display | 1.25–2rem | 600 | 1.2 | 0 |

**Rules:**
- Body text minimum 16px on mobile (prevents iOS auto-zoom)
- Max line length: 65ch desktop, 45ch mobile
- Tabular numbers (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) on all prices and data
- Never truncate headings — always wrap

### Spacing System

Base unit: **4px**. All spacing values are multiples of 4.

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon gap, tight inline |
| `space-2` | 8px | Minimum touch gap, tight list items |
| `space-3` | 12px | Input padding horizontal |
| `space-4` | 16px | Card padding (mobile), form gap |
| `space-5` | 20px | Button horizontal padding (sm) |
| `space-6` | 24px | Card padding (desktop), section inner |
| `space-8` | 32px | Component gap |
| `space-10` | 40px | Section padding (mobile) |
| `space-12` | 48px | Section padding (desktop inner) |
| `space-16` | 64px | Section gap (mobile) |
| `space-20` | 80px | Section gap (desktop) |
| `space-24` | 96px | Hero padding |
| `space-32` | 128px | Large section gap |

### Elevation & Shadow

| Level | CSS | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| 0 — Flat | `none` | Nav items, inline text elements |
| 1 — Soft | `0 1px 3px rgba(42,21,10,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(42,21,10,0.04)` | Cards at rest, inputs |
| 2 — Card | `0 4px 6px rgba(42,21,10,0.07), 0 12px 24px rgba(42,21,10,0.08)` | Hovered cards, dropdowns |
| 3 — Float | `0 8px 16px rgba(42,21,10,0.10), 0 24px 48px rgba(42,21,10,0.12)` | Modals, drawers |
| 4 — Overlay | `0 20px 60px rgba(42,21,10,0.20)` | Toasts, tooltips |

*Shadows use warm espresso-tinted black, not pure black, to stay on-brand.*

### Animation Tokens (Framer Motion)

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `duration.fast` | 150ms | Button press, state changes |
| `duration.base` | 250ms | Card hover, fade transitions |
| `duration.slow` | 400ms | Page transitions, modals |
| `duration.crawl` | 600ms | Hero entrance (first load only) |
| `ease.enter` | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1]` | Elements entering viewport |
| `ease.exit` | `[0.4, 0.0, 1, 1]` | Elements leaving |
| `ease.spring` | `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }` | Interactive press feedback |
| `ease.springGentle` | `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 120, damping: 20 }` | Page/modal transitions |
| `stagger.list` | 40ms per item | Product grids, lists |
| `stagger.hero` | 80ms per word/line | Hero text reveal |

**Animation rules:**
- Only animate `opacity` and `transform` (translateY, translateX, scale) — never `width`, `height`, `top`, `left`
- Exit duration = 60–70% of enter duration
- Always include `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback (disable translate, keep opacity)
- Interactive press: `scale: 0.97` on tap, spring back on release
- Hover lift on cards: `y: -4px` + shadow level up, `duration.base`
- Stagger grids: fade+translateY(16px) → (0, 0), 40ms stagger
- Page transition: `opacity: 0→1` + `y: 12→0`, `duration.slow`, `ease.enter`
- Modal: scale `0.96→1` + `opacity: 0→1`, spring gentle
- Drawer: `x: -100%→0`, spring gentle

### Component Specifications

#### Button
```
Primary:   bg-espresso-800  text-white  hover:bg-espresso-700  active:scale-[0.97]
Secondary: border-stone-300 text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-100
Ghost:     text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100
Danger:    bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700

Sizes:
  sm:  px-3 py-2    text-sm  rounded-lg  min-h-[36px]
  md:  px-5 py-2.5  text-base rounded-lg min-h-[44px]  ← default (meets touch target)
  lg:  px-7 py-3.5  text-lg  rounded-lg  min-h-[52px]

States: transition-colors duration-150 | disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed
Animation: whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} (Framer Motion spring)
```

#### Input
```
border-stone-300 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 bg-white text-stone-900
focus:ring-2 focus:ring-espresso-500 focus:border-transparent
placeholder:text-stone-400
error: border-red-400 focus:ring-red-400
min-height: 44px (touch target)
```

#### Card
```
bg-white rounded-xl shadow-soft border border-stone-100
hover: shadow-card transition-shadow duration-200
  + motion.div whileHover={{ y: -4 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
```

#### Product Card
```
aspect-ratio: 4/3 for image (use aspect-[4/3])
Image: object-cover, lazy loading, group-hover scale-105 (or Framer whileHover)
Name: Inter 600 stone-900
Price: Playfair Display 600 espresso-800, tabular-nums
Category: badge espresso-100/espresso-700
Tasting notes: italic stone-500 text-sm line-clamp-1
Origin: uppercase stone-400 text-xs tracking-widest
Stock badge: "Only N left" amber-100/amber-800 when stock ≤ 5
```

#### Badge / Status
```
Order status:
  pending:    bg-amber-100  text-amber-800
  confirmed:  bg-blue-100   text-blue-800
  processing: bg-amber-100  text-amber-800
  shipped:    bg-blue-100   text-blue-800
  delivered:  bg-green-100  text-green-800
  cancelled:  bg-red-100    text-red-800

Roast:
  light:  bg-amber-50  text-amber-700
  medium: bg-orange-50 text-orange-700
  dark:   bg-stone-100 text-stone-700

Stock:
  in-stock:   text-green-700
  low (≤5):   bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 "Only N left"
  out:        bg-stone-100 text-stone-500 "Out of stock"
```

#### Navbar
```
sticky top-0 z-50
bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm border-b border-stone-200
height: 64px (h-16) — meets touch target for all items
Logo: Playfair Display 600 espresso-950
Nav links: Inter 500 stone-600 → hover:stone-900 transition-colors
Cart icon: 24×24px, badge: espresso-800 bg, white text, rounded-full
Mobile: hamburger at ≥ md:hidden → slide drawer from left (Framer Motion x: -100%→0)
```

#### Skeleton
```
bg-stone-200 animate-pulse rounded
Use for: product grids, cart, orders, dashboard stats
Never show a loading spinner for content lists — use skeletons
```

#### Toast
```
react-hot-toast
Position: bottom-right on desktop, bottom-center on mobile
Style: bg-stone-900 text-white rounded-xl shadow-float px-4 py-3 text-sm
Success: left border-l-4 border-green-500
Error:   left border-l-4 border-red-500
Duration: 4s auto-dismiss
aria-live="polite" (non-intrusive)
```

#### Modal
```
Backdrop: bg-espresso-950/50 backdrop-blur-sm
Content: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-overlay max-w-md/lg
Animation: scale 0.96→1 + opacity 0→1 (springGentle)
Close: ESC key + click backdrop + explicit × button
Focus trap: active while open
```

### Accessibility Requirements

- All interactive elements: visible `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-espresso-500 focus:ring-offset-2`
- Minimum contrast: 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text, 3:1 UI components
- Touch targets: minimum 44×44px (use `min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]`)
- Icon-only buttons: always include `aria-label`
- Images: always include `alt` attribute (empty for decorative)
- Form inputs: always have visible `<label>` (not placeholder-only)
- Skip-to-content link: first focusable element in `Layout.tsx`
- `prefers-reduced-motion`: wrap all Framer Motion in `useReducedMotion()` check

---

## Step 3 — Page-Specific Notes

### Home Page (`/`)
- Hero: full-width, `bg-espresso-950`, editorial typography, single CTA
- Features strip: `bg-espresso-50`, 3 columns, icon + title + description
- Product grid: lazy animate-in on scroll (`whileInView`, `once: true`)
- Subscription CTA: `bg-stone-900`, centered, generous padding

### Products Page (`/products`)
- Filter bar: sticky below navbar, `bg-white border-b border-stone-200`
- Empty state: serif headline, friendly copy, back-to-shop link
- Pagination: simple prev/next, current page indicator

### Product Detail (`/products/:slug`)
- Image: left (desktop), top (mobile); `aspect-square rounded-3xl`
- Breadcrumb: `text-stone-500 text-sm`, meets WCAG §9 breadcrumb rule
- Quantity: inline stepper, min-h-44px per button
- Add to cart: full-width on mobile, right-aligned on desktop
- Reviews: below fold, star rating + comments

### Cart (`/cart`)
- Items: `AnimatePresence` list with slide-out on remove
- Summary card: sticky on desktop (`sticky top-24`)
- Empty state: serif copy, prominent shop link

### Admin
- Dashboard: stat cards + recharts (bar + donut)
- Products table: horizontal scroll on mobile
- Orders table: status badge + action buttons

---

## Pre-Delivery Checklist

- [ ] All interactive elements ≥44px height
- [ ] Contrast ≥4.5:1 for all body text (check stone-500 on white = ✓ 5.1:1)
- [ ] No emoji as icons
- [ ] Skeleton screens on all async content >300ms
- [ ] All animations use only `opacity` and `transform`
- [ ] Animation durations 150–400ms
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` handled via `useReducedMotion()`
- [ ] Mobile tested at 375px — no horizontal scroll
- [ ] Focus rings visible (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-espresso-500`)
- [ ] All `aria-label` on icon-only buttons
- [ ] Toast uses `aria-live="polite"`
- [ ] Modal traps focus
- [ ] Tabular numbers on all prices
